clue.text: Cold, white wine unfinished — a little sweet

explanation.walkthrough: Hock is the British name for Rhine wine; cutting its last letter and putting C in front gives CHOC.

clue.text: Throne decorated with navy line

clue.text: A-listers living the high life?

the same sense again

clue.text: Good Lord, what's seen on election of new Pope?

definitions.text: what's seen on election of new Pope?

blocks.clueFragment: what's seen on election of new Pope?
blocks.note: second meaning, read literally: sacred fumes rising from the Sistine Chapel chimney

explanation.walkthrough: When cardinals elect a Pope, white smoke rises from the chapel chimney, and that smoke is quite literally holy.

clue.text: Competition number, neither the first nor the last

taken as written
